entry_state: Covered-loss revisions affect issued and held groups separately without duplicating the component movement. A qualifying modification uses an independently supplied equivalent premium;deemed premium is not cash. Future-service changes use CSM before loss. Fixed and variable payments need different finance allocations. Loss components share finance as well as service release. A holdings change preserves the old OCI schedule under frozen assumptions while new finance follows the new policy. Section12.12.4 begins at300 with derecognition and OCI origin and continues after300.
exit_state: OCI recycling depends on its origin; mixed-origin early termination remains unresolved. Claim marginals leave treaty recovery dependent on joint parameter a. The tiny triangle supplies reserve148 but no predictive law. Mean uncertainty and process variation both matter, and matching moments does not match tails. The whole triangle and latest diagonal define different conditioning questions. Forward Mack moments do not imply a backward law. Reserve-error centering subtracts paid claims on both sides. Section12.16.2 continues after306 with the published comparison and its limits.

findings.observation: The transition from finance origins to claims preserves unresolved interactions and makes the missing joint law concrete through treaty recovery20a.
The bootstrap argument distinguishes random means, actual payments, sparse-data failure and claims-development horizons. Source and software mismatches are stated with their local scope.
Finite examples explain conditioning, asymptotic scales, backward-law insufficiency and reserve centering before a reader is asked to interpret the cited consistency claims.
